preconditions.description: The input must be provided via stdin.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.data <= 1000 for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: The data of each node must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if the tree is cloned successfully.
The output must be '0' if the tree is not cloned successfully.
